**Best estimate:** **DKK 34,000,000** in Danish retail CSD sell-out value for **HARBOE** in **2026-01**.

**Range:** **DKK 26,000,000–44,000,000**  
**Confidence:** **Low-to-moderate (~45% that actual lands in this range)**

**Rationale:** I interpret “sell” as **retail value sales in DKK** for carbonated soft drinks in Danish retail. Harboe reported that its Beverage Denmark revenue was rising due to wider distribution and product launches, and that Harboe products were represented across almost the entire Danish retail sector by 2025/26. It also reported that Danish soft-drink sales rose 2.6% over the prior year and that summer weather materially affects demand, making January a below-average month. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/33c7dc53-b05d-3479-890b-eb407fb6b860/report.pdf)) A prior Harboe annual report put its soft-drinks value share at **8.1%** over the MAT period, and its newer report indicates continued brand/distribution support into early 2026. ([harboes.gcs-web.com](https://harboes.gcs-web.com/static-files/88ec4164-f72a-4d68-95b6-f85bb8680432)) As a cross-check, DTU/Euromonitor data indicate Danish retail soft-drink volumes are large—966m liters in 2025 for the broader soft-drinks grouping—so a low-double-digit-million monthly DKK estimate for Harboe CSD is plausible. ([food.dtu.dk](https://www.food.dtu.dk/english/-/media/institutter/foedevareinstituttet/publikationer/pub-2025/markeds-og-vareundersoegelse-af-energidrikke-i-danmark-final-report.pdf))
